items.name: button
items.title: Irina Button
items.description: A button that reacts like an anime impact frame: it squashes when pressed, inverts for one frame on release, and a burst goes off behind it with clouds and ドン!. A secondary variant is quieter. One file, no dependencies, defines <irina-button>.
items.author: dayy4dev <https://github.com/dayy4dev>
items.docs: Irina Button is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /irina-fx/button.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <irina-button>Confirm</irina-button> (variant="secondary" for the quiet one). Listen for click; call el.done() when the action worked to land a check on it. More: https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-fx

items.name: toggle
items.title: Irina Toggle
items.description: A switch whose flip is 43 painted frames: the knob smears across, slams into the end, throws up a splash, and the track floods and settles. The frames are inside the file (about 500 KB). One file, no dependencies, defines <irina-toggle>.
items.author: dayy4dev <https://github.com/dayy4dev>
items.docs: Irina Toggle is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /irina-fx/toggle.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <irina-toggle label="Notifications"></irina-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-fx

items.name: slider
items.title: Irina Slider
items.description: A range slider whose thumb stretches and lags on a spring, with cumulus rolling up behind a fast drag and a crescent thrown ahead on release. One file, no dependencies, defines <irina-slider>.
items.author: dayy4dev <https://github.com/dayy4dev>
items.docs: Irina Slider is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /irina-fx/slider.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <irina-slider value="30" label="Volume"></irina-slider>, with min, max, step and unit. Read el.value; it fires input and change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-fx

items.name: radio
items.title: Irina Radio
items.description: A radio group whose picked dot springs in with a fan of wedges, two puffs and a hollow ポン. One file, no dependencies, defines <irina-radio>.
items.author: dayy4dev <https://github.com/dayy4dev>
items.docs: Irina Radio is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /irina-fx/radio.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <irina-radio label="Plan"><option value="a" selected>Option A</option><option value="b">Option B</option></irina-radio>. Read el.value and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-fx

items.name: input
items.title: Irina Input

items.docs: Irina Input is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /irina-fx/input.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <irina-input label="Name" placeholder="Type something"></irina-input>. Read and set el.value; it fires input and change. items.name: tabs
items.title: Irina Tabs
items.description: Tabs where the raised tab slides to the one you pick, stretching, and lands with wedges and a puff. One file, no dependencies, defines <irina-tabs>.
items.author: dayy4dev <https://github.com/dayy4dev>
items.docs: Irina Tabs is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /irina-fx/tabs.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <irina-tabs label="Sections"><option>Home</option><option>Profile</option></irina-tabs>. Listen for change (e.detail: index, value, label) and show the panel yourself. More: https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-fx

items.name: progress
items.title: Irina Progress
items.description: A loading bar with a storm cloud riding its leading edge, pebbles lifting off the ground and ゴゴゴゴ; at the end a burst, ドン! and a check. One file, no dependencies, defines <irina-progress>.
items.author: dayy4dev <https://github.com/dayy4dev>
items.docs: Irina Progress is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /irina-fx/progress.js with a script tag (not a module), then use <irina-progress label="Loading"></irina-progress>, then el.set(n) with progress from 0 to 1. Listen for irina:done (fires once). el.reset() for the next task. More: https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-fx

Read el.value (0 to 5) and listen for change. Works in forms with a name. More: https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-fx

items.name: toast
items.title: Irina Toast
items.description: A notification that streaks in as a smear, lands in dust with ズザッ, wobbles and leaves by shrinking. One file, no dependencies, defines <irina-toast>.
items.author: dayy4dev <https://github.com/dayy4dev>
items.docs: Irina Toast is a plain script that registers a custom element. Load /irina-fx/toast.js with a script tag (not a module), then use Put <irina-toast></irina-toast> where toasts should appear and call el.show("Saved"). It stays for the duration attribute (2.6 s) or until el.hide(). More: https://github.com/dayy4dev/irina-fx
